Senses.Explanation: To pierce through the nostrils is to catch someone so completely that the person can be led by the nose. Chan speakers make a staff, whisk, or verbal dilemma perform the piercing, marking mastery over every position the other party might take. Chulin Shangrui says Xinghua’s staff pierces even a traveler who claims not-west and returns east. Huiyue Xu raises Tianyi Huai’s staff piercing both buddha and demon, then disputes the appraisal. Yichu Wuyuan says speaking and not speaking are equally pierced. Tianyin Yuanxiu says his whisk pierces the nostrils of the old masters he has just raised.
